entry.title: Washington Nationals roster moves and needs: Paul Toboni published a long letter to Nationals fans in which he discussed last season, the offseason and objectives for 2027. No earth-shattering news, but this was perhaps the most-notable section:
Evan Phillips: Evan Phillips should be a top free agent target for the Washington Nationals
Duncan Davitt: The #reds have claimed off waivers RHP Duncan Davitt from the Giants and RHP Paxton Shultz from the Nationals.

Nate Furman: Parker and Tena are probably the most-notable moves here. Parker was going to arbitration-eligible after having TJ surgery in July. Tena was out of options and less defensive value than the just-acquired Nate Furman.

Tony Neubeck: The Nationals announce they've acquired 2B/3B Nat Furman from the Giants for minor-league LHP Tony Neubeck. Furman, 25, played in 22 MLB games this season, going 4-for-32. Lefty hitter slashed .292/.377/.414 at AAA. Has 2 more option years. LHP Richard Lovelady was DFA'd to clear a 40-man spot.
Braxton Roxby: First of many offseason transactions by the Nationals: They have claimed RHP Braxton Roxby off waivers from the Giants and DFAd RHP Zak Kent to clear a 40-man roster spot.

Stephen Strasburg: After delivering the best season by a Nationals pitcher since 2019 and becoming their first pitcher to sign an extension since Stephen Strasburg, the expectations for Cade Cavalli will be sky high next year. natsjournal.com/p/expectatio...
